domains.title: Compiled application-role codec
domains.compatibility_rule: The compiler selects the role codec required by the exact manifest schema and rejects unknown role bytes.
domains.breaking_when: Existing role artifacts stop decoding or the schema-to-codec selection changes without a new identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V3 remain current for declaration-free roles; V4 carries compiler-derived secret-output atoms; V5 carries exact symbolic vector-inspection authority; V6 carries bounded candidate-source and root-order authority.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published role codec numbers are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0174/WP-734 bounded candidate authority codec V6

domains.title: Application installation plan
domains.compatibility_rule: The compiler preserves V1 without reimport or secret authority, uses V2 only for reimport without secret authority, and uses V3 whenever any query-secret-output atom exists; unknown readers refuse before mutation.
domains.breaking_when: Frozen V1 or V2 bytes change, a known plan stops decoding, V3 authority atoms can be ignored, or the least-sufficient writer changes without a new identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 and V2 remain current for secret-free plans; V3 is current for plans carrying exact secret-output authority and may also carry reimport identity.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published installation-plan schema names and authority atom shapes are never reused.

domains.title: Compiler-owned application lock
domains.compatibility_rule: The source schema selects the least-sufficient exact lock; V8 pins exactly the V7-declared generated surfaces plus mandatory compiler artifacts, and older locks retain strict byte-exact writers and decoders.
domains.breaking_when: A previously accepted lock changes meaning, stops decoding without retirement, or loses an exact identity pin.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V7 remain writable for their exact source generations; V8 is current for sparse V7 sources.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published lock schema names and fields remain reserved.

domains.title: Resolved application manifest
domains.compatibility_rule: Resolution selects the exact manifest required by its source schema; V5 carries exactly the sparse V7 surface set and older manifests retain strict byte-exact writers and decoders.
domains.breaking_when: An existing manifest schema changes meaning or a strict decoder is removed without retirement evidence.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V4 remain writable for their exact source generations; V5 is current for sparse V7 sources.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published manifest schema names and fields remain reserved.

domains.title: Application role-definition format
domains.compatibility_rule: The exact lock binds the compiled role definition and current generation writes V3.
domains.breaking_when: A frozen definition changes bytes or an older exact lock can no longer be checked.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 and V2 are read-only; V3 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published role-definition numbers are never reused.

domains.title: Author-owned application source
domains.compatibility_rule: Existing source versions retain exact writers and decoders; V7 is selected only for a nonempty closed sparse generated-surface declaration.
domains.breaking_when: An existing source document changes meaning or an older source loses its explicit decoder.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V6 remain writable for existing applications; V7 is current for selective package surfaces.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published source schema names and fields remain reserved.

domains.title: Alpha durable epoch and writer identity
domains.compatibility_rule: Only manifest-declared release edges authorize an offline transition; decoder success alone does not.
domains.breaking_when: The epoch changes, or a writer transition lacks the exact receipted upgrade and refusal ceremony.
domains.supported_release_posture: Writer 0 is the sole declared predecessor; writer 1 is current in alpha epoch 1.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Epoch/writer pairs are monotonic identities and are never reused.

domains.title: Closed authoritative catalog root
domains.compatibility_rule: The retained root accepts only the digest of the sole storage-owned catalog; unknown catalogs refuse without partial authority or diagnostic disclosure.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 69, revision 1, its field, or catalog binding changes meaning.
domains.supported_release_posture: Codec registered during WP-772; persistence requires complete receipted V3 activation, not yet enabled.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Tag, revision and field number are never reused.

domains.title: Physical backup manifest
domains.compatibility_rule: A backup is restorable only within its declared physical compatibility range.
domains.breaking_when: A current backup stops verifying or replacing a target can begin before compatibility validation.
domains.supported_release_posture: Backup manifest V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Backup manifest versions and fields are never reused.

domains.title: Lineage-shared authoritative history roots
domains.compatibility_rule: Exact lineage, anchor, materialized tail and minimum resume positions bind hashes and dual frontiers. Root decoding never grants publication or reclamation.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 71, revision 1, fields, lineage, position, hash, frontier or retention-floor semantics change.
domains.supported_release_posture: Codec and installation primitive implemented in WP-772; production startup activation is not enabled.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Tag, revision and field numbers are never reused.

domains.title: Physical changelog transaction allocator
domains.compatibility_rule: Physical transaction allocation uses its own registered envelope; nonzero Next and explicit Exhausted cannot be confused with application or administration allocation.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 68, revision 1, field numbers, nonzero allocation, exhaustion, or the complete-envelope journal precondition changes.
domains.supported_release_posture: Codec registered during WP-772; persistence requires the complete atomic V3 activation migration, not yet enabled.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: The tag, revision and Protobuf field numbers are never reused.

domains.title: Schema-bound columnar projection control
domains.compatibility_rule: Revision 1 is the sole schema-bound scalar/vector selector; impossible pointer, evidence, role, lifecycle, failure, and retention shapes refuse.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 67, revision 1, source keys, Protobuf fields/enums, lifecycle shapes, or CAS selector semantics change.
domains.supported_release_posture: Tag 67 revision 1 is current; legacy tag 65 is structurally readable but inert until WP-757 removes it.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: The tag, revision, field numbers, enum values, and source bytes are never reused.

domains.title: Contract-migration check receipt
domains.compatibility_rule: Receipts are checksummed exact-version external artifacts and unknown versions fail closed.
domains.breaking_when: Receipt bytes or validation semantics change under version 2.
domains.supported_release_posture: Receipt V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Receipt versions are never reused.

domains.title: Stored record envelope
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 and V2 are bounded checked envelopes; new records use V2.
domains.breaking_when: Frozen envelope bytes change or an unsupported envelope reaches mutation.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 is read-only; V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Envelope versions, tags, and field numbers are never reused.

domains.title: Exact-text provider checkpoint
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 retains compile-only hash/value state; V2 adds canonical keys and typed outputs; V3 binds one typed equality dimension; V4 additively binds the complete compiler-owned predicate/order program; V5 additively binds explicit nullable state placement while preserving the same authorized count/ordinal epoch contract.
domains.breaking_when: Checkpoint framing, canonical row order, state-placement/profile meaning, provider binding, or recovery/refusal semantics change under any admitted V1 through V5 identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 is readable compile-only state; narrow providers write V2/V3, present-only exact predicate providers write V4, and nullable exact-order providers write V5.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Checkpoint versions, framing tags, field order, and profile tags are never reused.

domains.title: Pre-open durable format marker
domains.compatibility_rule: The fixed checksummed sidecar is validated before redb opens.
domains.breaking_when: Marker validation, checksum coverage, or pre-open ordering changes incompatibly.
domains.supported_release_posture: Marker V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Marker versions and magic values are never reused.

domains.title: Durable-format upgrade receipt
domains.compatibility_rule: The exact checksummed receipt makes the one-way upgrade resumable.
domains.breaking_when: A receipt no longer recovers every accepted/migrated/marker crash boundary.
domains.supported_release_posture: Upgrade receipt V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Upgrade receipt versions are never reused.

domains.title: Durability journal extent
domains.compatibility_rule: Extent generation and position framing remain exact and crash validated.
domains.breaking_when: Extent bytes, fence recovery, or generation semantics change under version 3.
domains.supported_release_posture: Journal extent V3 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Journal extent versions are never reused.

domains.title: Durability journal frame
domains.compatibility_rule: Frames are bounded, checksummed, position-bound, and replayed only after validation.
domains.breaking_when: Frame bytes or replay semantics change under version 2.
domains.supported_release_posture: Journal frame V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Journal frame versions are never reused.

domains.title: Lineage-shared leadership epoch
domains.compatibility_rule: Leadership is a distinct nonzero fence with checked advancement; transaction and incarnation counter records cannot substitute for it.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 70, revision 1, its field, zero refusal or checked advancement changes meaning.
domains.supported_release_posture: Codec registered during WP-772; persistence requires complete receipted V3 activation, not yet enabled.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Tag, revision and field number are never reused.

domains.title: Long-pattern provider checkpoint
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds the exact matching profile and every compiler-owned bound, then canonically retains each entity-key digest, complete matched value, value digest, distinct byte trigrams, and compiler-shaped release bytes. Postings are rebuilt and revalidated from these rows before publication.
domains.breaking_when: RLPV framing, canonical row or gram order, bound meaning, matched-value/digest/gram semantics, release meaning, or recovery/refusal behavior changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Long-pattern provider-state V1 is current, derived, rebuildable, and activated only through the checksummed generation checkpoint owned by the server projection runtime.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Checkpoint versions, magic bytes, field order, profile tags, and framing widths are never reused.

domains.title: Offline maintenance receipt
domains.compatibility_rule: Create/restore and retire operations intentionally emit their closed receipt versions.
domains.breaking_when: Either operation class changes frozen bytes or accepts an unknown receipt.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 create/restore and V2 retire receipts are both current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Maintenance receipt versions are never reused.

domains.title: Durable receipt union
domains.compatibility_rule: The release manifest retains the closed union of maintenance receipt identities.
domains.breaking_when: A receipt family enters or leaves the union without its own governed transition.
domains.supported_release_posture: Receipt union V1 and V2 are current for distinct operation classes.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Union members remain reserved even after a future retirement.

domains.title: Durable record registry
domains.compatibility_rule: The generated registry digest binds the complete readable and writable record inventory.
domains.breaking_when: Tags, revisions, hashes, or registry bytes drift without a durable transition.
domains.supported_release_posture: Registry V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Record tags, revisions, schema hashes, and symbolic types are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0149 / WP-684 correlated index-work command authority

domains.title: redb physical layout
domains.compatibility_rule: The closed redb table/key layout is opened only after format preflight.
domains.breaking_when: Table, key, or singleton layout changes incompatibly under version 1.
domains.supported_release_posture: redb layout V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Physical layout identities and keys are never reused.

domains.title: Follower-local durable attachment and progress
domains.compatibility_rule: Explicit detached or lineage-bound applied and optional acknowledged positions; acknowledgement never outruns or substitutes applied state. Missing state is not detached.
domains.breaking_when: Tag 72, revision 1, closed state, fields, positions or acknowledgement meaning changes.
domains.supported_release_posture: Codec implemented in WP-772; production attachment and follower apply are not yet enabled.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Tag, revision and field numbers are never reused.

domains.title: Tokenized-text provider checkpoint
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds one text-index identity, analyzer, policy partition, generation, frontier, canonical keys and outputs, field norms, and explicit per-field postings with frequencies and positions.
domains.breaking_when: RTTS framing, canonical order, analyzer or field identity, posting/frequency/norm/position meaning, or recovery/refusal semantics change under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Tokenized provider-state V1 is current and rebuildable.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Checkpoint versions, framing bytes, field order, and analyzer tags are never reused.

domains.title: Authoring diagnostic evidence format
domains.compatibility_rule: Structured diagnostic fixtures preserve code, span, and safe-message meaning.
domains.breaking_when: A diagnostic fixture cannot be interpreted under its declared identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: Diagnostic evidence V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published diagnostic identities and codes are never reused.

domains.title: Deterministic simulator trace
domains.compatibility_rule: Seeded traces bind the resolved schedule and replay under the same trace identity.
domains.breaking_when: Digest or replay interpretation changes under trace version 3.
domains.supported_release_posture: Simulator trace V3 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Trace versions are never reused.

domains.title: Derived columnar physical encoding registry
domains.compatibility_rule: Registry V1 is the closed exact fixed-width, offset/canonical, dictionary/ordinal, Boolean bitmap, and checked-delta family; unknown tags fail before use.
domains.breaking_when: An existing physical encoding tag or canonical byte rule changes under registry identity 1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Registry V1 is production-active only inside a complete selected Segment V2 generation; databases whose durable control selects layout V1 continue to use the independent row framing.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Encoding registry identities and tags are never reused.

domains.title: Derived columnar generation root
domains.compatibility_rule: Root V1 canonically binds one complete bounded V2 partition inventory, physical format tuple, incarnation, generation, matched frontier, counts, lengths, and checksums.
domains.breaking_when: Root magic, field order, numeric identity, physical-fingerprint preimage, filename derivation, bounds, checksum, or canonical inventory rules change under identity 1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Root V1 is the current complete V2 generation publication artifact.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Generation-root identities, field positions, and physical tuple components are never reused.

domains.title: Derived columnar layout
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 remains readable and writable for a database whose durable control selects V1; V2 can replace it only as one exact disjoint generation after matched-frontier publication.
domains.breaking_when: A known layout is reinterpreted, V1 becomes unreadable, or V2 is selected without its accepted publication proof.
domains.supported_release_posture: Layouts V1 and V2 are production-readable and writable; each database serves exactly its durable selected layout, remains on V1 until complete V2 publication, and never falls back from a corrupt selected V2.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Layout versions are never reused.

domains.title: Derived columnar generation manifest
domains.compatibility_rule: Manifest V1 remains readable and writable for selected layout V1; Manifest V2 binds one partition, definition, incarnation, generation, frontier, exact segment inventory, lengths, and checksums inside a disjoint V2 generation root.
domains.breaking_when: A known manifest is reinterpreted, mixed identities are accepted, or candidate bytes become publishable without WP-711 lifecycle proof.
domains.supported_release_posture: Manifest V1 and V2 are production-active within their selected layouts; Manifest V2 becomes servable only through one completely validated and durably selected generation root.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Manifest identities and field positions are never reused.

domains.title: Compiled exact-text named query
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds the exact provider family, stages, fixed text member, total order, and bounded window parameters; V2 additionally binds one compiler-resolved field identity and its typed optional parameter.
domains.breaking_when: RXCQ framing, versioned field order, parameter meaning, or exact member semantics change under an existing identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 remains current for unfiltered exact queries; V2 is current for one finite typed equality filter.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Compiled exact query versions, field positions, and parameter meanings are never reused.

domains.title: Contract bundle framing
domains.compatibility_rule: The compiler emits the oldest bundle capable of representing the exact contract without loss.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical bytes or semantics change under an existing bundle version.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V23 are active least-sufficient outputs; compiler-sealed command decisions require V18, partition-local cross-aggregate conflict ownership requires V19, tokenized text-index declarations require V20, long-pattern declarations require V21, compiler-proved command inputs above 1 MiB require V22, and collection plans above legacy 256-element or mutation-instance semantics require V23.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Bundle versions, tags, and stable IDs are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0177/WP-745 compiler-bounded high-cardinality collection bundle V23

domains.title: Contract grammar identity
domains.compatibility_rule: Grammar identity advances only for source constructs that require a distinct checked representation.
domains.breaking_when: Existing source parses or resolves differently under its declared grammar identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V23 are active least-sufficient identities; text_index syntax requires V20, pattern_index syntax requires V21, a compiler-proved command input above 1 MiB requires V22, and high-cardinality collection semantics require V23 without new source syntax.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Grammar identities and syntax meanings are never reused.

domains.title: Executable contract IR
domains.compatibility_rule: IR identity is selected with the bundle from visible static dependencies and exact semantics.
domains.breaking_when: An instruction or schema node changes meaning under an existing IR identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 through V23 are active least-sufficient identities; tokenized text-index schema metadata requires V20, long-pattern metadata requires V21, the compiler-proved maximum for a command input above 1 MiB requires V22, and high-cardinality collection validation requires V23.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: IR identities, tags, and stable IDs are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0177/WP-745 compiler-proved high-cardinality collection executable IR V23

domains.title: Exact-text finite plan family
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds one field, closed exact operator and total-order masks, complete policy shape, static bounds, and one exact provider descriptor digest.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical family bytes, operator/order tags, tie-breaker meaning, policy shape, or bound meaning changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Exact-text plan-family V1 is current as a compile-only foundation artifact.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Plan-family versions, tags, masks, and field positions are never reused.

domains.title: Named exact-text plan binding
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds one checked symbolic query name to the domain-separated hash of one canonical exact-text plan family without changing query-module V1 through V4.
domains.breaking_when: Binding framing, operation-name semantics, or family-hash interpretation changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Exact-text query binding V1 is current as a compile-only foundation artifact.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Binding versions, framing tags, and operation identities are never reused.

domains.title: Named exact-text result-set binding
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds one symbolic operation to a complete exact family and runtime-bounded result-set V2 plan, with canonical cross-validation of the provider descriptor.
domains.breaking_when: Binding framing, family bytes, runtime window bounds, provider identity, or operation-name semantics change under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Exact-text result-set binding V1 is current for activated exact named reads.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Binding versions, framing tags, and operation identities are never reused.

domains.title: Exact binary UTF-8 semantic profile
domains.compatibility_rule: binary_utf8_v1 freezes exact byte equality, prefix, suffix, and containment with typed empty-needle refusal and missing/null non-match semantics.
domains.breaking_when: Comparison, canonical binding, value/needle maxima, or missing/null behavior changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Exact-text semantic profile V1 is current but has no public execution surface until WP-647.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Semantic profile versions, operator tags, and canonical parameter framing are never reused.

domains.title: Stable-ID lineage ledger
domains.compatibility_rule: V2 preserves allocation history, tombstones, and permanent rename aliases.
domains.breaking_when: Stable IDs, aliases, or tombstones can be reallocated or forgotten.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 is read-only; V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Allocated and tombstoned IDs remain reserved permanently.

domains.title: Compiler-owned MCP command-name registry
domains.compatibility_rule: Command tool names are compiler-owned, collision-checked, and carried in the exact bundle.
domains.breaking_when: A stable command identity maps to a different public tool name under registry V2.
domains.supported_release_posture: Command-name registry V2 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published tool names and registry identities are never silently reused.

domains.title: Migration bundle framing
domains.compatibility_rule: A V1 migration binds one exact parent and candidate with canonical bytes.
domains.breaking_when: Bundle bytes, domain-separated hashes, or exact-parent semantics change under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Migration bundle V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Migration bundle identities and step tags are never reused.

domains.title: Migration grammar identity
domains.compatibility_rule: Migration source is parsed under a bounded exact-parent V1 grammar.
domains.breaking_when: Existing migration source changes meaning under grammar V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Migration grammar V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Migration grammar identities and syntax meanings are never reused.

domains.title: Executable migration IR
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 migration plans expose every deterministic bounded step statically.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 step or resource-bound meaning changes.
domains.supported_release_posture: Migration IR V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Migration IR identities and step tags are never reused.

domains.title: Sealed projection-provider descriptor
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 seals one real provider family, posture, closed capabilities, policy mode, freshness and lifecycle semantics, finite cost/retention/lease bounds, and provider-state schema identity.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical descriptor bytes, capability meaning, provider posture, policy ranking, or bound meaning changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Projection-provider descriptor V1 is current for the independent columnar, vector, and exact-text conformance foundations.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Provider kinds, capability bits, policy tags, descriptor versions, and hash-domain labels are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0131 exact-text provider-kind admission under descriptor V1

domains.title: Named projection result-set binding
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 binds one exact symbolic query name to one independently versioned sealed result-set plan without changing query-module V1 through V4.
domains.breaking_when: Binding framing, name semantics, or embedded-plan interpretation changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Projection result-set binding V1 is current as a compile-only foundation artifact and is not publicly executable.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Binding versions, framing tags, and named operation identities are never reused.

domains.title: Projection result-set semantic plan
domains.compatibility_rule: V1 fixes one concrete compiler-owned window; V2 keeps the same six stages and typed output while binding compiler-owned maximum offset/limit for typed runtime window values.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical bytes, six-stage ordering, window semantics, output shape, or provider-digest binding changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: V1 remains current for fixed windows; V2 is current for generated runtime-bounded ordinal operations.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Plan versions, stage flags, window tags, and output tags are never reused.

domains.title: RiffQL executable query IR
domains.compatibility_rule: Each closed plan family emits its own registered query IR identity.
domains.breaking_when: A plan family changes semantics under its existing query IR identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: Query IR V1 through partition-set V17 remain current; bounded relational-operator V18 is additive.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Query IR identities, node tags, and cost meanings are never reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0185/WP-768 bounded relational-operator query IR V18

domains.title: Immutable query-module codec
domains.compatibility_rule: Module codec follows the closed query-plan family and validates exact contract identity.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical module bytes or plan-family selection changes under an existing version.
domains.supported_release_posture: Module V1 through partition-set V17 remain current; bounded relational-operator module V18 is additive.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Module identities and query names are never silently reused.

domains.title: Reactive operation IR
domains.compatibility_rule: Reactive plans bind exact event, query, command, and contract identities.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 reactive operation changes triggering or invocation meaning.
domains.supported_release_posture: Reactive IR V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Reactive IR identities and operation hashes are never reused.

domains.title: Reactive module framing
domains.compatibility_rule: Canonical V1 module bytes bind all reactive operations and their exact plans.
domains.breaking_when: Module bytes or operation-hash composition changes under V1.
domains.supported_release_posture: Reactive module V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Reactive module identities are never reused.

domains.title: RiffQL language identity
domains.compatibility_rule: Core and operational source forms have explicit bounded language identities.
domains.breaking_when: Existing RiffQL source parses or plans differently under its declared identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: Core V1 through bounded Set V13 remain current; bounded relational-operator syntax V14 is additive.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Language identities and syntax meanings are never reused.

domains.title: Generated agent guidance
domains.compatibility_rule: One generated teaching source feeds repository rails and application guidance.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 consumer receives an incompatible structure or unsafe guidance.
domains.supported_release_posture: Agent guidance V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Guidance schema names are never reused.

domains.title: Generated application operation catalog
domains.compatibility_rule: V2 contains only unpaged MCP-visible queries; V3 adds the disjoint SDK-only secret-output registry; V4 adds exact symbolic vector-inspection operations and retains V3 when both apply; V5 strictly retains all predecessor fields and adds compiler-owned pagination annotations and result envelopes only for MCP-visible paginated queries.
domains.breaking_when: An unpaged V2 through V4 entry changes bytes, a secret query becomes MCP-visible, an SDK or vector operation loses exact identity, V5 omits a required predecessor registry, or selection is not the least-sufficient identity.
domains.supported_release_posture: V2 is current with none of SDK-only, vector, or pagination features; V3 is current for SDK-only without vector or pagination; V4 is current whenever vector inspection exists without pagination and retains SDK-only entries; V5 is current whenever an MCP-visible query paginates and retains either predecessor registry when present.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Generated schema and operation identities are never silently reused.

last_change.decision: ADR-0194/WP-701 paginated named-query MCP catalog V5

domains.title: Driver conformance manifest
domains.compatibility_rule: All language manifests use one conformance schema and bind the shared corpus.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 manifest stops expressing the required cross-language evidence.
domains.supported_release_posture: Driver conformance manifest V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Conformance schema names and language identities are never reused.

domains.title: Development registry publication plan
domains.compatibility_rule: One immutable development build identity maps deterministically into four loopback registries.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 plan changes publication identity or permits development artifacts into signed release qualification.
domains.supported_release_posture: Development registry plan V1 is current and non-production.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Plan identities and published immutable coordinates are never reused for different bytes.

domains.title: Signed driver distribution plan
domains.compatibility_rule: The signed plan binds versions, platforms, artifacts, checksums, and the durable manifest.
domains.breaking_when: V1 cannot express a release artifact or its compatibility binding.
domains.supported_release_posture: Driver distribution plan V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Distribution schema names and published package coordinates are never reused for different bytes.

domains.title: Driver package matrix
domains.compatibility_rule: The closed matrix keeps package identity and runtime ownership aligned across ecosystems.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 matrix cannot state an ecosystem package or safe runtime dependency.
domains.supported_release_posture: Driver package matrix V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Matrix schema names and package roles are never reused.

domains.title: CLI machine-output envelope
domains.compatibility_rule: Machine mode uses one closed JSON envelope and typed safe errors.
domains.breaking_when: Required V1 fields or their meanings change incompatibly.
domains.supported_release_posture: CLI output V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: CLI schema fields and typed error codes are never reused.

domains.title: Application driver-host protocol
domains.compatibility_rule: The Rust host accepts V1 legacy invocations, V2 additive compact-query negotiation, V3 additive packed-query compatibility, and V4 additive AdmissionHead query consistency; older protocols cannot submit or silently downgrade the stronger guarantee.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 legacy, V2 compact, or V3 packed frame changes meaning, a compact/packed result bypasses exact generated layout validation, or AdmissionHead is accepted below V4.
domains.supported_release_posture: Driver protocol V4 is current; V1 through V3 remain read-only compatible without AdmissionHead negotiation.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Protocol versions, opcodes, and fields are never reused.

domains.title: Model Context Protocol baseline
domains.compatibility_rule: RiffDB advertises and accepts only the pinned external MCP baseline.
domains.breaking_when: The advertised baseline changes or behavior diverges from its conformance suite.
domains.supported_release_posture: MCP 2025-11-25 is the sole external baseline.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: External baseline dates are never relabeled as another protocol.

domains.title: Operator driver-host protocol
domains.compatibility_rule: Operator frames remain separate from application authority and are bounded by the Rust host.
domains.breaking_when: A V1 operator frame changes meaning or crosses into application authority.
domains.supported_release_posture: Operator driver protocol V1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Operator protocol versions, opcodes, and fields are never reused.

domains.title: Generated application gRPC package
domains.compatibility_rule: Generated application RPCs remain additive within the v1 package and bind exact operation identities.
domains.breaking_when: A published field, enum, method, or meaning changes incompatibly within riffdb.app.v1.
domains.supported_release_posture: riffdb.app.v1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published Protobuf fields, enum values, and method identities remain reserved.

domains.title: Canonical transactional value codec
domains.compatibility_rule: Canonical typed values preserve exact decimal, ordering, and domain-separated hashing semantics.
domains.breaking_when: Canonical bytes or value meaning changes under 0x01.
domains.supported_release_posture: Canonical value codec 0x01 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Value tags and codec identities are never reused.

domains.title: Public gRPC package
domains.compatibility_rule: Public Protobuf evolution is additive within v1 and checked by descriptors and wire fixtures.
domains.breaking_when: A published field, enum, method, or meaning changes incompatibly within riffdb.v1.
domains.supported_release_posture: riffdb.v1 is current.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published Protobuf fields, enum values, and method identities remain reserved.

domains.title: Durable storage Protobuf package
domains.compatibility_rule: The package namespace is stable; concrete durable record revisions are governed by the durable registry.
domains.breaking_when: A published durable field, enum, tag, or meaning changes outside the record registry and epoch ceremony.
domains.supported_release_posture: riffdb.storage.v1 is current; its record window is separately enumerated by the durable manifest.
domains.reserved_identity_policy: Published Protobuf fields, enum values, record tags, and package identities remain reserved.
